description: This PHP source file defines the class AOPInboundEmail, which extends InboundEmail to handle processing of inbound emails, including embedding images, creating cases from emails, and handling auto-replies in a SuiteCRM environment.

classes.name: AOPInboundEmail
classes.description: A subclass of InboundEmail that adds custom processing for emails, including handling embedded images and creating support cases.

methods.name: processImageLinks
methods.description: Replaces embedded image links with links to the corresponding notes or attachments within the CRM.

methods.name: handleCreateCase
methods.description: Creates a new case in SuiteCRM from an email, linking notes, accounts, and contacts, and optionally sending an auto-reply.
